tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ rig 'dus tshe sgrub tshogs brgya 'chi bslu bcas gtong tshul/ rtsa gtor/ gsol ka skong bshags/ rgyun gtor/ dkar bgegs/ chad brtan/ tshogs 'byor pas 'dzoms tshad/ 'chi bslu glud chen spar btab ci 'dzoms/ nam rgyang*/ mda' 'phang*/ pho tang mo tang*/ shing ris/ nam mkha' bcas ci 'dzoms/ glud chung brgya/ ril bu brgya/ chang bu brgya bcas/ 'don 'grigs/ sems bskyed sdom chog brgyud 'debs/ skyabs sems/ yan bdun/ dkar bgegs nas/ bstod pa yan/ phaṭa dzaḥ nas dzapra khang dbye/ hrīḥ tshe dbang= tshe bsnyen stong*/ mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gang rung*/ yig brgya/ tshe 'gugs/ yo ga bzhi dril/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ āḥ 'byung lnga'i= rak+ṣa:bar/ tshogs byin rlabs/ skong bshags rdo rje'i thol glu/ 'brel ba'i lhag ma yan/ yo ga bzhi dril byed na/ byin brlabs mthar/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ spyan 'dren/ zhi rol rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ ḍā/ mchod pa/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ bar bshags/ nṛ tri badz+ra= bsgral bstab/ zhi rol/ dung*/ rkang bzhi/ skong bshags/ sa mā dzaḥ zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ rkang bzhi/ ḍā/ mthar zhi rol/ mdor na bskyur/ lhag ma byin rlabs/ puṣ+pe= zhi rol/ dkar/ dung*/ ḍā/ lhag ma la zhi rol/ dkar/ dung*/ rkang bzhi/ ḍā/ de nas tshar grangs ji 'don bzhi bcad kho nas bya chog kyang*/ lan re tsam 'don rta/ zhi rol bya na/ mchod rlabs rtsa gdangs bzhi dril/ shab+da= zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā/ rkang bzhi/ sarba pañtsa= lha bskyed lnga btegs bzhi dril/ spyan 'dren thugs thig 526) bzhi dril/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ rkang bzhi/ ḍā/ bzhugs/ phyag mchod pa/ yo ga gnyis btegs bzhi dril/ shab+da= zhi rol/ rgya/ dung dkar/ rkang bzhi/ ḍā/ dril stabs/ bstod pa rtsa gdangs/ rigs lnga spyi phyag dzapra dmigs lhug hrīḥ dgu brgya/ tshe bsnyen brgya/ ye shes lha tshogs= zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā/ tshe 'gugs/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ bstimaḥ tshogs sngar ltar/ skong ba/ bde stong klong yangs=

lta bu/ rdzogs pa chen po'i sa la skyolaḥ tshar phyi ma'i tshe 'gugs/ rak+ṣaḥ rjes gsol ka yongs rdzogs/ dam can rgya mtsho= na rag skong bshags/ tshogs byin rlabs/ rnga rdung rgyun ltar/ bsgral bstab rjes/ mkhyen brtse'i skong bsdus/ chos dbyings khyab rdal= lta bu/ tshogs rdzas= grangs bsag gangs can= grangs bsag mdor na= tshogs drang ba/ bsam lhun/ rig 'dzin bla ma'i sangs rgyas kun 'dus= lhag ma byin rlabs/ lhag ma bcas/ de nas 'chi bslu/ sngags drug phyag drug thing*/ sil/ rkang bzhi/ dung*/ dgu thing gis yum ka'i bla bslu'i/ kyeḥ sangs rgyas rkang gnyis= 'dur/ ngag la nyonaḥ dgu thing*/ kyeḥ bla ma yi dam= khro bo kha bsgyur/ dgu thing*/ bla tshe/ bla lug zhes pa'i tshig rkang gnyis bla bslu'i dus ma gtogs 'dir mi dgos pas dor ba 'og ma thams cad la 'gres/ kyeḥ stong gsum= byin gyi nus pa bzhi la dgu thing bzhi/ bla kun gdon la bzhi la dgu thing bzhi/ mthar 'ur/ rkang gsum/ 527) ༄༅/ sngags gong 'og gnyis bla bslu ma gtogs 'dir mi dgos/ glud chung*/ ril bu/ chang bu rnams re re bzhin/ glud chen du dor zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ saṃ bha ra= khyer cig khyer cig= tshar brgya/ thal mo re re brdab/ 'dir spro na dpal chen seng gdong gang rung gi sgo dbye rol mo bcas/ gtor bzlog dus ltar dkar lam 'then/ gzhung bskul/ chad tho/ bla bslu'i/ 'ur/ rkang bzhi/ dgu thing gis/ kyaiḥ stong gsum= deng 'dir mdzodaḥ dgu thing*/ bden pa'i= bzhin du bsgrodaḥ dgu thing*/ 'ur/ rkang bzhi/ dgu rdung glog mas/ drag rdung chung bas/ rgyan gyi brgyan par= 'dur/ (Musical notes and signs here) gdon khyed rang gi gnas su songaḥ nas/ 'ur thung*/ che mchog pad+ma/ tshar gsum/ rkang bzhi/ snga phyi gnyis la yod/ mdos phyir bskur/ dkar lam phyir phyag 'ur/ rkang bzhi/ drag rdung chung bas/ srung 'khor/ 'ur/ rkang gsum/ bzhag rol/ gsol ka bkyags/ mtha'i 'ur/ sum gnyis/ brtan ma rgyun ltar yin/

zhus so/ gur drag gi che mchog pad+ma/ zil/ (Musical notes and signs here) rkang*/ che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal thod phreng rtsal/ thod phreng rtsal dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de 'dra lan gsum/ zil/ bzhag
